settings.section_label: Fuel for adventures that ignite the soul
settings.heading: Omawild is a conservation-led food brand born from our adventures through tropical jungles, coral reefs, and regenerative farms.
settings.content: Our story began during an expedition across Bali, in a season of change when little made sense except for the conservation work that kept calling us back to Indonesia. That journey led us into communities protecting forest reserves, restoring coral reefs, and improving soil health across some of the most biodiverse places on this planet. Those experiences left us changed, inspiring us to create Omawild: a brand built on the belief that the places we love are worth protecting.

settings.heading: Adventures leave us changed
settings.content: Adventure has a way of putting life into perspective. It invites us beyond the boundaries of what we know, awakening a sense of wonder that's easy to lose in the rush of everyday life. And it's those moments that move us most that we remember longest. They remind us of the magic of being alive. But the greatest adventures leave us with more than memories. They deepen our connection to the people and places that make those experiences possible. They help us see that we are part of something larger than ourselves.

settings.heading: Food felt like the natural place to begin
settings.content:
Every ingredient begins with healthy ecosystems because healthy land grows healthy food, and healthy food nourishes healthy people.

We partner with producers who share our commitment to organic, regenerative, and responsible farming practices, and contribute at least 1% of our annual sales to environmental organizations through the 1% for the Planet network. Together, we're building an outdoor pantry that celebrates the places we love while helping protect them for generations to come.

settings.heading: A different way of being
settings.content: Our adventures across Indonesia changed the way we saw the world. While we had spent a decade improving people's lives, it was there that we were reminded our wellbeing has always depended on the health of our planet. Healthy soil grows nourishing food. Biodiversity creates resilient and thriving ecosystems. Our wellbeing has never been separate from the planet, because we are nature.

settings.heading: Food felt like the natural place to begin
settings.content:
Food is not something we simply consume, but a direct expression of our relationship with the world. Every breath we take, every meal we eat, and every sip we drink begins in living ecosystems. Healthy land grows healthy food, and healthy food nourishes healthy people.

That understanding shaped the way we built Omawild. We partner with producers who share our belief that the future of food depends on thriving ecosystems, and support farming practices that regenerate the land rather than deplete it.

Our commitment extends beyond the farms we source from. As members of 1% for the Planet, we contribute at least 1% of our annual sales to environmental organisations restoring ecosystems, protecting biodiversity, and supporting communities on the frontlines of environmental stewardship.

What begins with coffee is part of a larger vision at Omawild: to build an outdoor pantry that fuels our adventures while helping protect our home planet for generations to come.
